build_scenario: build a meltingpot scenario by name with an optional substrate transform for training
build_scenario_from_config: build a meltingpot scenario from a ScenarioConfig with an optional substrate transform
get_scenario_config: get the ScenarioConfig for a specified scenario by name
get_scenario_factory: get the ScenarioFactory for a specified scenario by name
list_scenarios_by_substrate: list all scenarios grouped by their underlying substrate name
